candidates.outcome: Validate/re-encode/store a user image and return a usable reference
candidates.notes: Contract storage visibility, RLS and host-owned policy; compose with image-prep, never duplicate transform.

candidates.outcome: Create/read/reply/react in governed threaded discussions
candidates.notes: Moderation, auth, cascade and abuse boundaries make extraction heavy.

candidates.outcome: Award bounded XP/badges/quests from verified product actions
candidates.notes: Server-authoritative award path is valuable; duplicated constants expose drift risk.

candidates.outcome: Discover, rate and verify stores by location
candidates.notes: Split directory core from map/geocoding Bridges and moderation.

candidates.outcome: Exchange private messages with read/typing/report controls
candidates.notes: PII, realtime, abuse, retention and user-block policy are high-gravity.

candidates.outcome: Earn/spend/cap/audit product credits
candidates.notes: Atomic spend path is strong evidence; earn/stipend consistency and fraud invariants need formal proof.

candidates.outcome: Turn noisy comparable observations into robust price insight
candidates.notes: Split pure robust statistics from eBay OAuth/query/cache Bridge and write-through.

candidates.outcome: Enforce tiered usage allowance and account for consumption
candidates.notes: Entitlement, concurrency and fail-open/closed semantics need hard contract.

candidates.outcome: Publish approved events and manage attendance intent
candidates.notes: Timezone, moderation, capacity and cancellation semantics need boundary.

candidates.outcome: Publish canonical crawlable product/content truth
candidates.notes: Separate canonical publication model from framework/render Bridge.

candidates.outcome: Save and replay user searches under entitlement policy
candidates.notes: Good retention primitive; should connect to notifications but not require them.

candidates.outcome: Export user-owned collection data as a portable document
candidates.notes: Separate data projection from layout/PDF/print Bridge.

candidates.outcome: Produce and deliver consent-aware transactional notifications
candidates.notes: Template shell and delivery Bridge currently coupled/incompletely wired.

candidates.outcome: Maintain owned items, copies, condition/accessories/notes and collection state
candidates.notes: Central VTC capability; large current component must be decomposed into state core + presentation/workflows.

candidates.outcome: Maintain wanted items and discover community overlap
candidates.notes: Strong portable collection-commerce capability; photo and social lookup optional.

candidates.outcome: Create/search/remove member listings and surface matches
candidates.notes: Messaging, credits and matching must remain separate dependencies, not bundled.

candidates.outcome: Publish a bounded member profile, flair and showcase
candidates.notes: Auth/profile data and privacy settings are dependencies; gamification flair optional.

candidates.outcome: Queue, review, approve/reject and audit user/content reports
candidates.notes: Broad authority today; candidate should be provider-neutral moderation case/decision core.

candidates.outcome: Register threshold alerts against watched market observations
candidates.notes: Needs scheduler/notification Bridge later; registration/evaluation can be separate.

candidates.outcome: Accept/reject catalogue corrections, photos and wiki contributions with provenance
candidates.notes: Useful for heritage/catalog products; should generalize contribution proposal + review rather than VTC schema.

candidates.outcome: Identify candidate catalogue items from user media and return bounded matches
candidates.notes: AI/provider/embedding/auth/credit dependencies require clean Bridges and confidence contract.

candidates.outcome: Move content ideas through draft/review/approval/assets/publication with evidence
candidates.notes: Strong transferable publishing capability; agent execution is Workflow/Bridge, not core identity.

candidates.outcome: Provide installable PWA shell with safe offline fallback and static caching
candidates.notes: Service-worker policy is portable; host supplies asset list and navigation strategy.

candidates.outcome: Deliver bounded in-product notifications tied to product events
candidates.notes: Separate notification record/read state from channels.

candidates.outcome: Collect and aggregate member ratings for directory entities
candidates.notes: Can generalize as reviews/ratings capability; authenticity/moderation critical.

candidates.outcome: Represent and resolve variants/signatures of a canonical catalogue item
candidates.notes: Useful for collectibles/parts/catalogs; VTC-specific schema must be abstracted.

candidates.outcome: Aggregate owned-item observations into collection valuation
candidates.notes: Depends on market-price insight plus collection state; good composition candidate rather than monolith.

candidates.outcome: Assign bounded product roles and scopes
candidates.notes: High authority; prefer generic RBAC contract, database/auth Bridges.

candidates.outcome: Track bounded product/business bookkeeping entries and summaries
candidates.notes: Potential generic small-business capability; inspect schema before extraction.

candidates.outcome: Publish and consume curated product news items
candidates.notes: May collapse into editorial-pipeline presentation unless independent behavior proves value.

candidates.outcome: Attach and surface product documents/paperwork with provenance
candidates.notes: Generic asset/document attachment seam; storage/publication Bridges separate.

candidates.outcome: Allow a user to block peer communication
candidates.notes: Likely sub-capability/required Port of messaging rather than standalone official Block.

candidates.outcome: Resolve feature availability from declared flags and aliases
candidates.notes: Useful substrate, but not user-meaningful enough for official product Block by current doctrine.

candidates.outcome: Search/filter/browse a structured public catalogue
candidates.notes: Broad reuse and central to many Blueprint families; split query contract from UI/storage Bridge.
